config.seeds: one per incident (see the suite); twin.seed is the smallest

eval.executed: SageMaker training job started by tools/sm/run.py; in-process twin, no network twin
eval.evidence_writer: tools/evlib.py: a local store in the job, uploaded and attested by tools/sm/entry.py

config.why_standin: suite t3-incidents-v2 was frozen with t3/evals/twin_standin.py, whose sinr_p10_db is the pooled-p10 mixture estimate; twin/kpis.py (W2, merged in int/v4) reports a user-share-weighted p10 instead, so the frozen post-fault KPIs would not replay. This run ships t3/evals, tools and contracts only (not twin/), so t3/evals/twin_backend.py selects the stand-in, as in W10's recorded offline runs.
